scope: Training-only URL-shape diagnostic; challenge is a small manually selected sanity probe, not a representative accuracy estimate

challenge.limitations: Includes recognizable ordinary login/article URL forms and example-domain probes; no page-fetch or independent labeling was performed. This exposed false-positive risks, not a new calibrated benchmark.

action: Raw URL model scores and test metrics retained unchanged; path/login inputs surface an inconclusive review warning. No domain allowlist was added. Representative current benign path data and independent source/time evaluation are required before a protection claim.
